comment: Local (MIT) lip-sync capability manifest — the offline alternative to the hosted syncso adapter. cost_per_second_usd is a KNOWN 0.0 (local inference, ADR-060 cost semantics). The lipsync_budget block mirrors the syncso sparse discipline: local renders are free but the QUALITY argument for sparseness is unchanged (singing lip-sync degrades fast off frontal close-ups) — the orchestrator enforces it BEFORE invoking the adapter. Every entry is documented-best-effort until a maintainer captures a trace against a real MuseTalk install (verified:false must be surfaced, never silently trusted).

musetalk-1.5.label: MuseTalk 1.5 (MIT) — local real-time-class lip-sync
musetalk-1.5.input_notes: local video_path + audio_path (local-source rule); ASSUMED CLI surface --video/--audio/--output via MUSETALK_CMD; GPU strongly recommended — CPU inference is minutes-per-second; quality degrades off frontal close-ups like every lip-sync model
